phase1_leaf_result.part103_scope: Two co-rollback histories and four observation classes in a deterministic finite model: repository-only image, content-addressed g3 effect ID, same-domain append-only evidence, and one rollback-independent high-watermark escape hatch.
phase1_leaf_result.new_falsification: When H0 never advanced beyond g3 and H1 advanced to g4 then all in-domain freshness evidence is restored to the exact H0 image, every deterministic repository-only protocol sees identical observations. Accepting g3 preserves H0 availability but is stale/unsafe in H1; rejecting g3 is safe in H1 but falsely excludes H0. Content-addressed effect naming and append-only evidence inside the same rollback domain do not change this result.
phase1_leaf_result.scope_limited_escape_hatch: A rollback-independent high-watermark can distinguish H0/H1, but if it changes publication acceptance it is functionally freshness authority and must itself satisfy the role's zero-dependency/zero-quota/no-protected constraints.
phase1_leaf_result.minimal_unresolved_child: A role-permitted Chat-native monotonic witness or sink floor that survives repository rollback and atomically fences stale generation/effect reuse without protected/admin/manual setup, richer-mode execution, finite monthly/trial/paid quota, external hosted coordination, or incremental cost.

phase1_acceptance.scope_guard: Only Part103's exact deterministic co-rollback finite model; no generalization to randomized protocols, hardware/external monotonic state, or untested repository retention guarantees.

continuation: Part104: execute exactly one bounded public-source/connector-capability leaf on whether an otherwise role-permitted GitHub-native object can provide a rollback-independent monotonic witness after force-rewind/delete-recreate without protected/admin/manual setup.
